question: Who among the following is an international shooting player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anjum Moudgil**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anjum Moudgil **is a sports shooter from India. She represents Punjab and is from Chandigarh.
 
• **GoSports Foundation** supports her through the Rahul Dravid Athlete Mentorship Program.
 
• Anjum Moudgil took silver in the **women's 10m air rifle event** at the ISSF World Championships in Changwon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Manju Rani** is an Indian boxer in the 48 kg category.
 
• **Jamuna Boro,** an Indian boxer.
 
• She belongs to Assam.
 
• **Laishram Sarita Devi** is a Manipur-based Indian boxer. In the lightweight division.
 
• she is a national champion and a previous world champion.
